name: @aoc-enterprise/soberania-runtime-closure
description: Installs the approved Soberanía runtime closure (FRONTERA-SOBE-PILOT-01C0) as production dependencies: the five executable runtimes, their two declaration packages and the @aoc/protocol candidate that @aoc-runtime/crypto requires at run time. Contains no code and exports nothing. No Frontera source consumes these packages yet, and the published @aoc-enterprise/runtime artifact neither depends on nor carries them.
